lines.text: The LORD tells Abram to count the sand, and Abram believes Him, and it is credited as righteousness.
The LORD reminds Abram He brought him out of Ur, and Abram splits animals but drives birds of prey away.
A smoking firepot and flaming torch pass between the halves, and the LORD gives land from Egypt to the Jordan.
